meta.name: Monster Hunter
meta.description: US Ranger Captain Artemis and her team are part of a UN joint security mission north of Hemat, in Afghanistan.  While searching for a missing team (Bravo), they are transported to a strange world where powerful monsters rule with deadly ferocity.  Faced with relentless danger, the team encounters a mysterious hunter who may be their only hope to find a way home.
meta.slogan: Behind our world, there is another.
